evidence: collision at t=103.683s with static arena_box_07 while robot moving at 1.01m/s
stall run shows robot stopped moving after 77.88s with mover at 2.14m and closing approach
time limit failure due to robot not reaching goal (final dist 30.2m) within 45.8s limit

assumptions.assumption: TTC < 2.0s is an appropriate trigger for evasion
assumptions.why: collision occurred despite TTC-based evasion; earlier trigger (1.0s) showed better results in previous attempts

assumptions.assumption: Evasion duration based solely on TTC and clearance validation is sufficient
assumptions.why: stall run shows robot unable to move despite evasion conditions; prolonged evasion or insufficient clearance check caused stall
review questioned tighter radius; attempt #6 with _ANCHOR_R=1.2m had higher pass rate (7/8) vs current 2/5

approach_families.result: 0.5s hold: 2/5 pass (turn 8), longer hold may reduce stalls
1.2m radius: better results than 0.8m in previous turn

candidates.idea: Lower _TTC_TRIG to 1.0s, increase _EVADE_HOLD to 1.0s, revert _ANCHOR_R to 1.2m
candidates.for: Earlier evasion trigger prevents late collisions; longer hold allows more maneuver time; larger anchor radius improves velocity estimation

candidates.idea: During evasion, prioritize static clearance over mover clearance when mover within 1.5m
candidates.for: Collisions with static obstacles occur during evasion; focusing on static safety avoids box collisions

candidates.idea: Add minimum 2s cooldown after evasion ends before re-triggering
candidates.for: Prevents rapid re-triggering due to TTC fluctuations; reduces unnecessary evasion

diagnosis.chosen: Lower _TTC_TRIG to 1.0s, increase _EVADE_HOLD to 1.0s, and revert _ANCHOR_R to 1.2m because earlier evasion trigger and longer maneuver window address both collision and stall issues, supported by higher pass rate in previous attempts with similar parameters
diagnosis.direction:
1. Set _TTC_TRIG = 1.0s to trigger evasion earlier when TTC drops below 1.0s
2. Increase _EVADE_HOLD to 1.0s so evasion extends at least 1.0s after TTC recovery
3. Revert _ANCHOR_R to 1.2m for better velocity estimation around movers
4. Adjust _EVADE_MAX to 8.0s to prevent premature evasion end in complex scenarios
5. In _choose, add static clearance bonus for paths maintaining >0.4m from static obstacles during evasion
6. Ensure evasion ends only when both TTC ≥ 1.0s and static clearance ≥ 0.3m for 0.5s
